zones.reason: the trace format's codec and a traces directory's layout: implements RunSource (model/) over the TraceFiles port infra's stores fit
the kernel: the universal trace in memory (trace/model), the recordings' words and ports, and the UI protocol; imports nothing
the arch module: styles, zones and their rules, the system graph drawn with them, placements, folder guides, and the advice prompts
the trace module: what two runs did differently (run and execution diffs, moves, routes, the review, replays)
the visualizer module: component, function and object views and the timeline, from the kernel's values
the explainer module: a review's Markdown and commit messages in, a checked explanation out, through the LanguageModel port
what the apps run: the recordings workflow, the review bundle, the viewer session; modules and the kernel, no IO of its own
the generic Node toolkit: text files, folders, the swap into place, the lock, hashing; no formats, and no other Runshape package
git, through its command line: implements the kernel's Repository port
asks GitHub, through gh, which pull requests request a review: implements the kernel's PullRequests port
the recorders: as a local process, or a commit in a Docker container; implement the kernel's Recorder port
language models: claude -p and the Anthropic API; fit the kernel's LanguageModel port
the recordings and reviews a project keeps (RecordingStore, ReviewStore, on infra) and the git refs they compare
the project's own working tree, for the recordings workflow: implements the kernel's ProjectFiles port
the command line: parsing each command into a call on the workflows' Recordings, the launchd job it prints, the composition root
